text:
maria gomez: FYI onboarding sample app spikes 429s on first-boot when it paginates + does parallel embed calls. Happens on local too.
alex chen: Ugh. Is this client-side limiter or server quota?
benji: Any stack / snippet?
maria gomez: Minimal repro: we call listPages() then map pages -> client.embeds in parallel with concurrency 8. On boot all pages queued, then token refresh kicks in and we start seeing 429s.
benji: Can you paste the fetch loop?
maria gomez: ```js
for await (const page of paginator()) {
  await Promise.all(page.items.map(item => client.embeddings.create({input: item.text})))
}
```
sophia li: That's a common pattern but it blows up with warmup bursts. If the SDK doesn't gate across pages you get a sudden multipage burst.
alex chen: Do you use the SDK built-in limiter? Which language?
maria gomez: JS SDK 0.24. Token refresh via oauth refresh token library that fires a background refresh on first request.
ciara-bot: deploy-notice: new sampleapp build succeeded for branch onboarding-warmup (ci/742) :white_check_mark:
benji: Two problems: 1) concurrency across pagination pages; 2) auth refresh triggers a retry storm when combined with retry-on-429 that requeues the same page.
sophia li: Workaround: sequentialize page processing and use per-request concurrency pool. Eg set page concurrency to 1 but process items with small pool.
alex chen: Also tweak SDK retry backoff: jitter + exponential backoff; avoid immediate retry on auth refresh.
maria gomez: Tried adding header { 'x-client-window': 'page' } kidding :) But seriously, code I changed:
```js
// naive fix
for await (const page of paginator()) {
  await pMap(page.items, item => client.embeddings.create({input: item.text}), {concurrency: 3})
  await delay(120) // tiny spacing to avoid bursting the server on warmup
}
```
benji: Did that remove 429s?
maria gomez: Reduced them to rare. Still saw a few when my local network had >100ms latency.
sophia li: Long-term we should add a sampleapp pattern in docs: 'pagination + rolling concurrency' and a small utility in SDK that gates across paginator instances (global token-bucket).
alex chen: SDK parity note: Go and Py SDKs already expose a global limiter option; JS currently only exposes per-client. We should add same config and default to safer limits.
benji: Also: retry behavior on 401 vs 429 should be decoupled. If token refresh caused 401 -> do single refresh and retry. If 429 -> exponential backoff without re-triggering refresh logic.
maria gomez: Filed https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-1823 with logs and sampleapp patch.
sophia li: For immediate DX fix can we update quickstart sample to process one page at a time and include recommended concurrency snippet?
alex chen: I'll open a PR to sample-apps repo with notes, and a small util in js-sdk called 'paginateGate' that ensures only N inflight requests across paginators.
benji: +1. Also add a test that simulates auth-refresh during a burst (mock timeouts/latency).
maria gomez: Thanks, folks. If we land sample fix early next week I'll retest onboarding flow. :thumbsup:
alex chen: ping @sophia li for review when PR ready.
ciara-bot: reminder: weekly-eng sync in 10m on #all-hands
